preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the graph is between 1 and 1,000,000, inclusive.
The number of edges in the graph is between 1 and 1,000,000, inclusive.
Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the graph.
No self-loops are present in the graph.

postconditions.description: The number of selected vertices is between 1 and n, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= q_i <= n for q_i in Q)
postconditions.description: Each selected vertex is a valid vertex index within the graph.

postconditions.expression: all(not is_reachable(q_i, q_j) for q_i in Q for q_j in Q if q_i != q_j)
postconditions.description: No two selected vertices are connected by an edge.

postconditions.expression: all(is_reachable(q_i, z) for q_i in Q for z in V if not q_i in Q)
postconditions.description: Every vertex not in the selected set is reachable from at least one selected vertex in no more than two moves.
